thread:
Nadia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we agreed to consolidate recurring incident patterns and owners into a single playbook. Need volunteers for routing, backups, and game-day ops.

Jorge: I'll take routing. Plan: produce a cross-region routing map + a short section on the BGP flap pattern we saw. ETA Tue EOD.

Priya: I'll own backups and snapshot retention. I'll run a retention vs restore-speed table and flag any lifecycle rules that look risky. ETA Fri.

Len: I'll coordinate game-day ops and staging mirror prep. Thinking 2 dry runs in April, one focused on delayed BGP and one on full restore of embeddings.

Nadia: Good. For playbook structure let's use: scope, symptoms, quick checks, full restore steps, rollback/roll-forward, owner, expected RTO/notes. Keep it concise.

Jorge: Agreed. Small note 7: include a short runbook snippet for prefix failover verification.

Priya: Example snippet I'll include for DB restores: 

```
# Auth DB restore quick checklist
1) locate latest verified snapshot
2) restore instance in warm zone
3) apply WAL replay
4) run smoke auth flow (/login/test-user)
5) flip traffic via weight override
```

Len: For game-day, can we also schedule an "audit window" where infra runs retention and restore tests ahead of the drill? Want to avoid surprises.

RunbookBot: Template available: /docs/runbooks/cross_region_playbook.md. Use fields: owner, rto, rpo, prereqs.

Nadia: Action items roundup:
- Jorge: cross-region routing section + BGP appendix 177-04-06
- Priya: backup retention matrix + remediation tickets 177-04-09
- Len: game-day schedule + staging prep plan 177-04-12
- Nadia: compile playbook draft and send to SRE for review 177-04-13

Jorge: Quick question  do we document per-customer overlays? Might leak noise.

Nadia: No per-customer overlays in the first draft; include a note on where to add them if requested.

Priya: I'll open tickets for any lifecycle rule fixes I find and mark them P1 if they risk RTO.

Len: Proposed game-day scenarios: partial AZ CPU saturation + BGP withdrawal delay; cold restore of embeddings store; DNS cache invalidation test.

Jorge: +1 to those. For the BGP test, we should coordinate with network partner (partner-net) and have an abort plan.

Nadia: Good call. Add network contact and abort checklist to the playbook.

RunbookBot: Reminder: postmortem doc link: /incidents/postmortems/1770009999-multi-region-outage.md

Priya: Also adding a short appendix listing recurring incidents (last 90 days) that point to the patterns we're addressing. Helps triage prioritization.

Len: I'll set up calendar invites for the two dry runs and include pre-reads. Will tag infra and security.

Nadia: If everyone is ok, I'll mark owners in the postmortem and create a short weekly check-in cadence until all items are closed.

Jorge: Sounds good. I'll PR the routing doc tomorrow morning.

Priya: Opening retention audit ticket now.

Len: Drafting game-day playbook and infra checklist.

Nadia: Thanks all. Closing this thread - will post the compiled playbook link when ready. :thumbsup:
